name: Case study body (platform)
purpose: Tell the customer story: a sticky table of contents beside the narrative chapters, a customer quote and a captioned video.
description: Article body of the case-study-platform template: a two-column layout with a sticky left TOC (section titles + Testimonial entry, scroll-spy highlight, sidebar demo card; the sidebar is hidden at 479 and below) beside the article (H2 + rich paragraphs per chapter, optional inline image), a testimonial card, and a serif video heading with a video placeholder and caption. The page's header (logo, H1, info cards) and closing CTA are separate sections (article.cs-platform-header, conversion.cs-platform-cta).

evidenceNotes: Per-route copy is generated by prose()/phrase() in src/pages/content/caseStudyPlatformData.js; the sample was evaluated with node from that file. Labels not set per route (tocLabel, testimonialLabel, sidebarCta, cta) come from the component DEFAULTS.
Route paragraphs carry no inline links; only the component DEFAULTS use [[link]] markers (up to 4 in one paragraph), so the rich budget follows the defaults.
Section `image` is a boolean in code (renders Placeholder "Inline image"); modelled as an optional media slot.

R6 decomposition (repository 3.0.0): split from the former single article.cs-platform-body (one section = the whole article, measured 4813px = 65% of /case-study/customer-1 at 1440px) along the component's own content boundaries.
